content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To visit some ancient ruins, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Apply for a foreign travel visa (3 weeks)
Step 2. Purchase international flight tickets (1 hour)
Step 3. Research the history of the archaeological site (4 hours)
Step 4. Buy a durable pair of hiking boots (2 hours)
Step 5. Visit a travel clinic for vaccinations (1 hour)
Step 6. Book a local guide for the ruins (30 minutes)
Step 7. Pack a specialized camera kit (45 minutes)
Step 8. Withdraw local currency from the bank (20 minutes)
Step 9. Arrange an airport shuttle service (15 minutes)
Step 10. Receive physical vaccination certificates (10 days)
Step 11. Read a biography of the ruins' discoverer (6 hours)
Step 12. Download offline GPS maps of the region (10 minutes)
Step 13. Arrive at the ancient ruins entrance (1 hour)
Step 14. Renew an expired passport (6 weeks)
Step 15. Purchase comprehensive travel insurance (30 minutes)
Step 16. Photocopy important travel documents (15 minutes)
Step 17. Pack a basic first-aid kit (20 minutes)
Step 18. Request time off from work (1 day)
Step 19. Check into the local hotel near the site (30 minutes)
Step 20. Buy a rugged backpack for the trek (1 hour)
Step 21. Confirm the shuttle pickup time (5 minutes)
Step 22. Meet the guide at the designated trailhead (15 minutes)
Step 23. Buy a high-capacity portable power bank (20 minutes)
Step 24. Pack waterproof clothing (30 minutes)
Step 25. Wait for the vaccination immunity period (2 weeks)
Step 26. Print out a detailed map of the ruins (5 minutes)
Step 27. Purchase a localized SIM card (15 minutes)
Step 28. Break in the new hiking boots (3 days)
Step 29. Research the local weather forecast (10 minutes)
Step 30. Charge all electronic devices (4 hours)
Step 31. Notify your bank of international travel (10 minutes)
Step 32. Order a specialized archaeology textbook (5 days)
Step 33. Present your ticket at the ruins gate (5 minutes)
Step 34. Take a taxi from the hotel to the site (45 minutes)
Step 35. Pack snacks and electrolyte powders (20 minutes)
Step 36. Search for the best flight deals (2 hours)
Step 37. Clean the camera lenses (15 minutes)
Step 38. Take a professional passport photo (30 minutes)
Step 39. Sleep for a full night to recover from jet lag (10 hours)
Step 40. Pack the day-bag for the excursion (20 minutes)
Step 41. Format the camera memory cards (5 minutes)
Step 42. Finish reading the archaeology book (8 hours)
Step 43. Purchase a wide-brimmed sun hat (30 minutes)
Step 44. Buy a heavy-duty water filtration bottle (15 minutes)
Step 45. Wait for the vacation request approval (3 days)
Step 46. Pack the hiking boots in the suitcase (10 minutes)
Step 47. Organize a travel itinerary folder (1 hour)
Step 48. Go to a sporting goods store for gear (1 hour)
Step 49. Save money for the trip expenses (2 months)
Step 50. Learn basic phrases in the local language (1 week)
